lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: GET AWAY FROM THE DOOR DADA [beat] YOU ARE ACTUALLY INSANE IF YOU THINK WE’LL JUST STAND HERE WHILE YOU LOCK US IN THIS FILTHY ATTIC!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: You always were the loud one Tuli [beat] but you fail to realize that this workshop has kept our family rich for three generations of lies!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Grandpa [beat] what are these blueprints on the table [beat] they look like the layout of every house in the neighborhood with red X's on them!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: Those aren't just houses Nix [beat] they are targets [beat] and your father was supposed to take over the operation before he got soft!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Don’t you dare bring Rafiq into your twisted games [beat] he left this house because he saw the monster you were becoming behind these walls!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: He left because he was a coward [beat] but you kids have the spark [beat] even if I have to break your spirits to make you useful to the legacy.

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: The floor is vibrating [beat] Nix look at the walls [beat] the shelves are sliding back to reveal some kind of high-tech surveillance room!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: He’s been watching everyone [beat] every single neighbor [beat] even my friends [beat] he’s been recording us for years through the vents!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: Information is the only real currency [beat] and now that you’ve seen the hub [beat] you either join the family business or you become a liability.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Is that a gas canister in your hand [beat] you wouldn't actually hurt your own grandchildren just to keep a secret about some spying ring!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: Family is a word for people who don't betray you [beat] and right now [beat] all of you look like a massive betrayal to everything I built.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The door just clicked [beat] he’s sealing the vents and the air is starting to smell like bitter almonds [beat] someone help us please!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Smash the window Nix [beat] use the heavy wrench on the workbench before we all pass out from whatever he just released into the air!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: That glass is bulletproof [beat] you’ll be asleep in thirty seconds [beat] and when you wake up [beat] we are going to have a very long talk!
